title: Bus event
description: Generated from src/events.catalog.yaml - do not edit by hand.

t.description: source time, ms on the page's monotonic clock

pt.description: A point in stage coordinates plus the client pixels it came from.

x.description: stage-normalized; may fall outside 0-1 if off-stage

target_ref.description: Result of a hit test; null when nothing was hit.

sample_stream.description: Chunked samples, rows are [t_ms, x, y] or [t_ms, x, y, pressure].

from_seq.description: last event that had been saved before the interruption

block_id.description: block that was resumed (null: only the end of the session was left)

t_dom.description: when the DOM was updated, before paint

planned_frames.description: the duration in display frames, when the phase is ended by its duration

stimulus_data.description: data returned by a custom stimulus generator (positions, identities)

frames.description: frames the phase lasted; more than planned_frames means a frame was late

rt_ms.description: from the onset of the current phase

occurrence.description: nth presentation of this stimulus in the trial

slop.description: max movement while pressed, CSS px
